name: MonarchAiAssistantPanel
title: AiAssistantPanel
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet on phones, or a Column pane the app places (for example the supporting pane of androidx.compose.material3.adaptive.layout.SupportingPaneScaffold), composing MonarchAiThread, MonarchAiPromptInput, MonarchAiContextChips, MonarchAiWelcome, MonarchAiStarterPrompts and MonarchAiAgentAvatar
summary: The assistant surface any app mounts: a header with the agent and close, chips for what the assistant can see on the current screen, and a thread over a prompt input, as a bottom sheet on phones or a pane on wide windows.
whenToUse: A product adds a general assistant beside its screens. Hold the MonarchAiConversation above the navigation so the conversation survives moving between screens, and open the panel from MonarchAiLauncher.
whenNotToUse: A full-screen chat product: use the ai-chat-page recipe. A single AI action on a record: use the action's own button and show the result with MonarchAiSummaryCard or MonarchAiInlinePrompt.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiAssistantPanel(title: String, messages: List<MonarchAiConversationMessage>, open: Boolean, onOpenChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, onSend: suspend (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placement: MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement = MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement.Auto, prompt: TextFieldState = rememberTextFieldState(), status: MonarchAiConversationStatus = MonarchAiConversationStatus.Idle, error: MonarchAiConversationError? = null, offline: Boolean = false, queuedCount: Int = 0, slow: Boolean = false, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = null, agentImage: Painter? = null, context: List<MonarchAiContextItem> = emptyList(), starters: List<MonarchAiStarterPrompt> = emptyList(), minimized: Boolean = false, onMinimizedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onStop: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRemoveContext: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, threadState: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), closeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeContextIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = closeIcon, minimizeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, headerActions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, toolbar: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, empty: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, promptFocusRequester: FocusRequester? = null, labels: MonarchAiAssistantPanelLabels = MonarchAiAssistantPanelLabels())

@ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiAssistantPanel(conversation: MonarchAiConversation, title: String, open: Boolean, onOpenChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placement: MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement = MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement.Auto, prompt: TextFieldState = rememberTextFieldState(), agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = null, agentImage: Painter? = null, context: List<MonarchAiContextItem> = emptyList(), starters: List<MonarchAiStarterPrompt> = emptyList(), minimized: Boolean = false, onMinimizedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onRemoveContext: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, closeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeContextIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = closeIcon, minimizeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, headerActions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, toolbar: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, empty: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, promptFocusRequester: FocusRequester? = null, body: Map<String, MonarchAiJSON> = emptyMap(), labels: MonarchAiAssistantPanelLabels = MonarchAiAssistantPanelLabels())
enum class MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement { Auto, Inline, Sheet }

class MonarchAiAssistantPanelLabels(close: String? = null, minimize: String? = null, expand: String? = null, inputLabel: String? = null, context: String? = null, welcome: String? = null, starters: String? = null, assistant: String? = null)

options.name: conversation
options.description: The conversation the panel shows and sends to. Its messages, status, error, connection, queue, slowness and agent are collected; sending calls send, and a refused send gives the text back to the prompt input; Stop calls stop.

options.name: title
options.description: The heading of the panel, such as "Assistant". It also names the pane (paneTitle) for TalkBack.

options.name: messages
options.description: The conversation, oldest first, shown by MonarchAiThread.

options.name: open
options.description: Whether the panel is shown.

options.name: onOpenChange
options.description: Called with false by the close button and, on a sheet, by the back gesture, a swipe down or a tap outside.

options.name: onSend
options.description: Sends the typed prompt or a chosen starter's prompt. Throw to give the typed text back to the prompt input.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the sheet or the pane. Give a pane a bounded height.

options.name: placement
options.description: Auto is a full-height bottom sheet on windows narrower than 640dp and a pane on wider ones; Inline is always a pane; Sheet is always a sheet.

options.name: prompt
options.description: The draft. It is kept while the panel is closed as long as the panel stays in the composition; hoist it to save drafts.

options.name: status
options.description: While Submitted or Streaming the avatar reads Working and Send becomes Stop; while a reply runs or a tool call awaits approval the starters are disabled.

options.name: error
options.description: The last turn's error, announced by the thread.

options.name: offline / queuedCount / slow
options.description: Passed to MonarchAiThread, which shows and announces its offline and slow notices.

options.name: agent
options.description: The agent in the header (name · role under the title) and in the welcome. Without one the avatar is named "Assistant" and no line is shown under the title.

options.name: agentImage
options.description: The agent's picture, loaded by the app; initials are shown without it.

options.name: context
options.description: What the assistant can see on the current screen, shown as MonarchAiContextChips above the thread.

options.name: starters
options.description: Suggested first prompts, shown under the welcome as a MonarchAiStarterPrompts list while the conversation is empty. Choosing one sends its prompt.

options.name: minimized
options.description: Collapses an inline pane to its header. Ignored on a sheet.

options.name: onMinimizedChange
options.description: Shows the minimize / expand button on an inline pane.

options.name: onStop
options.description: Stops the running reply, from the prompt input's Stop button and the Escape key of a hardware keyboard.

options.name: onRemoveContext
options.description: Lets the person remove a context chip by id.

options.name: threadState
options.description: The scroll position of the thread, kept while the panel is closed.

options.name: closeIcon / minimizeIcon
options.description: The app's glyphs (Monarch bundles no icons). With one, the button is a 48dp IconButton named by its label; without one, a small ghost button showing the label. The minimize glyph (a downward chevron) is turned up while collapsed.

options.name: removeContextIcon
options.description: The remove mark of the context chips, separate from the close glyph. It defaults to the close glyph, as before.

options.name: headerActions
options.description: Buttons before minimize and close, such as New conversation.

options.name: toolbar / footer
options.description: Passed to MonarchAiPromptInput: controls in its bar (a model picker) and content under it (MonarchAiDisclaimer).

options.name: empty
options.description: Replaces the whole empty state (the welcome and the starters).

options.name: promptFocusRequester
options.description: Moves focus to the prompt field, for example right after the app opens the panel. Passed to MonarchAiPromptInput.

options.name: body
options.description: Conversation overload only: extra request fields sent with each message from the panel, such as the selection the context chips show, merged over the conversation's own body. Read at each send.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: close, minimize, expand, inputLabel, context, welcome, starters, assistant.

states.name: closed
states.description: Nothing is shown. The draft and the thread's scroll position stay in the panel's state.

states.name: sheet
states.description: A full-height Material 3 modal bottom sheet with its drag handle; the back gesture, a swipe down or a tap outside closes it. There is no minimize button.

states.name: pane
states.description: A column on the surface color where the app places it, with a divider under the header.

states.name: minimized
states.description: A pane shows only its header; the button reads Expand assistant.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchAiWelcome with the agent, "How can I help?" and the starters, scrolling when the panel is short.

states.name: running
states.description: The avatar reads Working, Send becomes Stop and the starters are disabled.

states.name: awaiting approval
states.description: The starters are disabled; a typed prompt that the conversation refuses comes back into the prompt input.

states.name: offline / slow / error
states.description: MonarchAiThread shows and announces its notice or the error.

appearance: Every part is an existing component: the header is the small agent avatar, the title in the subheading style in the default text color with the agent in the muted caption color, and muted icon buttons or ghost buttons; a pane fills with the surface color and has the border-coloured divider under the header; the sheet uses the Material 3 sheet colors of the Monarch theme. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those roles and components.
platformNotes: The web panel docks to the right or left edge of the window and becomes a full-screen modal sheet under 640px. On Android the phone form is a full-height ModalBottomSheet and the wide form is a pane the app places, usually the supporting pane of SupportingPaneScaffold; the web's side option is therefore not offered, because the scaffold decides the edge. The web's Escape closes the panel when nothing runs and stops a running reply; on Android the sheet closes with the back gesture, the drag handle or a tap outside, the inline pane leaves the back gesture to the app's navigation (as MonarchAiArtifactCanvas does), and Escape on a hardware keyboard still stops a running reply through the thread and the prompt input. The web moves focus to the input when the panel opens and returns it on close; on Android the input is not focused on open, so the keyboard does not cover the conversation, and the sheet's own focus handling returns focus. Minimize applies only to the pane: a sheet already has the platform's dismiss. The web takes the useAiConversation hook; Android offers an overload that takes MonarchAiConversation and one that takes plain state, as Compose hoists state. The web's context chips are label and value pairs; Android reuses MonarchAiContextItem (kind and label). The web's messageProps, threadProps and promptProps pass-throughs are not offered; an app that needs them composes MonarchAiThread and MonarchAiPromptInput itself. Starters use MonarchAiStarterPrompts in its list layout instead of plain buttons. The web's container query that switches AI components to their narrow layout has no Compose counterpart; the components inside already lay out for the width they get. iOS has not covered this entry yet.
accessibility: The title is a heading and the pane title of the sheet or the pane, so TalkBack names the panel when it appears.
The close and minimize buttons are named by their labels ("Close assistant", "Minimize assistant" or "Expand assistant"), with a 48dp touch target, whether they show an icon or text.
The avatar in the header is decorative; the agent's name and role are text under the title.
The prompt input is named "Message the assistant"; Send becomes Stop while a reply runs.
The thread announces new replies, errors and the offline notice through its polite live regions.
Starters are disabled, not hidden, while a reply runs or a tool call waits for approval.
The layout mirrors right to left: the close button sits at the start edge.
edgeCases: Give an inline pane a bounded height: the thread is a lazy list and cannot sit in a vertically scrolling parent.
Keep the panel in the composition with open = false (rather than removing it) to keep the draft and the scroll position.
A long title wraps at font scale 2.0; the buttons keep their size.
A starter that the conversation refuses (for example while a tool call waits for approval) is not sent and shows no error.
With no agent and no role, no line is shown under the title.

examples.title: With AiLauncher and ⌘/Ctrl+J (inline placement)
examples.template:
Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchAiLauncher(
        open = open,
        onOpenChange = { open = it },
        variant = MonarchAiLauncherVariant.Subtle,
        showLabel = true,
        label = {{title}},
    )
    MonarchText(text = {{hint}})
}
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiAssistantPanel(
    conversation = conversation,
    title = {{title}},
    open = open,
    onOpenChange = { open = it },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space24 * 6),
    placement = MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement.Inline,
    minimized = minimized,
    onMinimizedChange = { minimized = it },
    minimizeIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronDown, contentDescription = null) },
    closeIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
    context = listOf(
        MonarchAiContextItem("page", MonarchAiContextKind.Page, {{context.0.items}}, group = {{context.0.label}}),
        MonarchAiContextItem("selection", MonarchAiContextKind.Selection, {{context.1.items}}, group = {{context.1.label}}),
    ),
    starters = listOf(
        MonarchAiStarterPrompt("sum", {{starters.0}}, {{starters.0}}),
        MonarchAiStarterPrompt("week", {{starters.1}}, {{starters.1}}),
        MonarchAiStarterPrompt("status", {{starters.2}}, {{starters.2}}),
    ),
)

examples.title: A pane beside the content, with minimize
examples.setup:
var messages by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<MonarchAiConversationMessage>()) }
var minimized by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiAssistantPanel(
    title = "Assistant",
    messages = messages,
    open = true,
    onOpenChange = { /* Hide the supporting pane. */ },
    onSend = { text ->
        // With a MonarchAiConversation, use the overload that takes it instead.
        messages = messages + MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = "u${messages.size}",
            role = MonarchAiRole.User,
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart(text)),
            createdAt = MonarchAiConversationMessage.timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()),
        )
    },
    modifier = if (minimized) Modifier else Modifier.height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space24 * 4),
    placement = MonarchAiAssistantPanelPlacement.Inline,
    agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = "Dossier", role = "Workspace assistant"),
    minimized = minimized,
    onMinimizedChange = { minimized = it },
)
